subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the RFC 27 grouped Claw schema, environment-gated core CLI, and versioned read-only plan as the supported base contract for the downstream Claws lifecycle stack?
rationale: This introduces a broad new core product and compatibility surface whose permanent schema, ownership boundaries, and rollout cannot be inferred safely while the RFC remains open.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Approve this base direction after the portable-path defect is fixed and exact-head CLI evidence confirms the final contract.

options.title: Pause for RFC revision
options.body: Keep the stack unlanded until RFC 27 settles the schema, lifecycle ownership, naming, and compatibility expectations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Approve this base direction after the portable-path defect is fixed and exact-head CLI evidence confirms the final contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has already reviewed the exact schema and planner boundaries in depth and is the strongest available routing candidate for confirming whether the repaired implementation matches the intended contract.
